blocks.text: Isaiah 53 contains 12 verses. It opens with: Who hath believed our message? and to whom hath the arm of Jehovah been revealed? It concludes with: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he poured out his soul unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors: yet he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
